lines.t: Search me, YahuShua…
Know my heart…
Show me the way…
Four years old, heard the door, felt the whole room shake,
Never knew if it was love or another soul-break.
One hand held a gift, one hand held the pain,
So I learned every smile could be followed by rain.
Little heart hiding, little mind on guard,
Trying to earn peace, trying to never be hard.
Mama had words, Daddy had fire,
I grew up thinking love came tied to a wire.
So I chased every glance that would make me feel seen,
Tried to fill an empty room with a temporary dream.
If she said I mattered, I could breathe for a night,
Then the fear came back heavy when she stepped out of sight.
I was angry, I was aching, I was begging for proof,
Built a palace out of sand, called the ceiling a roof.
But the storm kept coming, and the mask got thin,
I was fighting every shadow that was living within.
I said, “Why does it cut so deep?
Why do I run when I need relief?”
Then I heard truth in the quiet flame:
“Lay it down. Call on My Name.”
YahuShua, You’re the Way, You’re the Way,
When the darkness tells my heart to run away.
You’re the Truth when the lies become loud,
You lift my face when I’m buried in the crowd.
YahuShua, You’re the Life, You’re the Light,
Break the chains that have held me through the night.
I won’t bow to the wound, I won’t live by the pain—
YahuShua, You’re the Way, You’re the Way.
I wanted one thing: just to feel better fast,
But every false shelter made the hurt last.
Every rush said, “Come, I can silence the war,”
Then it left me more empty than I was before.
I confused being wanted with being made whole,
Confused a warm body with rest for my soul.
I confused loud passion with covenant love,
But nothing below could replace what’s above.
When rejection hit, it felt like the past,
Like the child in the room praying it wouldn’t last.
And I made my anger into armor and speech,
Tried to control what my fear couldn’t reach.
But You see past the anger, You know what it hides,
You see the scared little boy still alive inside.
You do not despise a heart torn apart,
You search the deep places, You heal the heart.
So I say, “Search me, show me what’s real.
Show me the fear underneath what I feel.
Teach me to listen, teach me to wait,
Teach me to love and not retaliate.”
YahuShua, You’re the Way, You’re the Way,
When the darkness tells my heart to run away.
You’re the Truth when the lies become loud,
You lift my face when I’m buried in the crowd.
YahuShua, You’re the Life, You’re the Light,
Break the chains that have held me through the night.
I won’t bow to the wound, I won’t live by the pain—
YahuShua, You’re the Way, You’re the Way.
Not by my striving, not by my rage,
Not by a feeling that fades in a day.
Not by the world and its glittering lies,
Not by the trap that says, “Compromise.”
I bring You my anger, I bring You my shame,
I bring You the memories I could not name.
I bring You my hunger, the need to belong,
Take what is broken and make it a song.
Search me and know me, try every thought,
Show me the places where fear has been taught.
If there is darkness, lead me from there,
Narrow is the Way, but I know You are near.
I will not accuse, I will not demand,
I will lay every weapon down in Your hands.
Mercy is stronger, Your love is enough,
You are my refuge when life gets rough.
I don’t need the counterfeit.
I don’t need the old escape.
I don’t need to earn Your love.
YahuShua—You are the Way.
YahuShua, You’re the Way, You’re the Way,
When the darkness tells my heart to run away.
You’re the Truth when the lies become loud,
You lift my face when I’m buried in the crowd.
YahuShua, You’re the Life, You’re the Light,
Break the chains that have held me through the night.
I lay it at Your feet, let Your will remain—
YahuShua, You’re the Way, You’re the Way.
Search me, YahuShua…
Know my heart…
Lead me in the way everlasting…
You are enough.
